description: High-performance structured logging for .NET 9. Striped async channel queue, MessageTemplate caching, object pooling, PII masking, correlation ID auto-propagation, per-sink minimum levels, per-category log levels, HTTP context enrichers (RequestId, UserContext), one-line correlation middleware, and built-in ASP.NET Core health check. MEL ILogger<T> compatible — drop-in replacement for Serilog/NLog.
releaseNotes:
v1.0.9 — v1.1 feature release
• Added: ISampler interface + PercentageSampler — probabilistic drop of Debug/Info/Trace events before enqueue; Warning/Error/Critical always pass through; ~2 ns overhead via Random.Shared
• Added: SinkSharpBuilder.WithSampling() — three overloads: SamplingOptions dict, rate+maxLevel simple, custom ISampler
• Added: SinkSharpBuilder.WithUserContext() and .WithUserContext(claims:[]) — no IHttpContextAccessor argument; accessor resolved from DI; fixes hardcoded sub/name/role ignoring AddSinkSharpUserContext(claims:[]) configuration
• Fixed: SinkSharpEnricherStartupService now delegates to registered UserContextEnricher singleton via per-invocation DirectBag (thread-safe); custom claim types now honoured correctly
• Fixed: SinkSharpBuilderTests parallel test isolation — IDisposable with constructor+Dispose resets static _runtimeLevel
• 240 tests passing
v1.0.8 — Correctness fixes
• Fixed: shared Task[] buffer data race in LogPipeline (2+ sinks) — ArrayPool<Task> per ProcessAsync invocation
• Fixed: sink exception permanently killed drainer stripe — per-sink try/catch, SinkFailureCount counter
• Fixed: pool leak on sink exception — ReturnToPool() moved to outer finally
• Fixed: TotalDropped always 0 — atomic per-stripe occupancy counter replaces unreliable TryWrite return value
• Fixed: critical drainer IndexOutOfRangeException — stripeIdx: -1 sentinel; Error/Critical now drain correctly
• Fixed: shutdown race — state machine (Accepting/Draining/Stopped) via Interlocked.CompareExchange
• Fixed: category prefix filter matched "Microsoft" against "MicrosoftExtra" — dot boundary required
• Added: SinkSharpLogger.ClearCallerCaptures() for test teardown; SinkFailureCount observable counter
• 230 tests passing
v1.0.7 — Bug fixes
• DrainAndStopAsync() waits for all drainer tasks — events no longer lost at shutdown
• Lock contention eliminated from hot path — enricher/capture lists lock-free on read path
v1.0.6 — HTTP context enrichers + runtime level control
• AddSinkSharpRequestId() — stamps RequestId from HttpContext.TraceIdentifier
• AddSinkSharpUserContext() — stamps UserId, UserName, UserRole (authenticated only)
• AddSinkSharpRequestPath() — stamps HttpMethod + RequestPath
• AddSinkSharpElapsedTime() — stamps ElapsedMs; requires app.UseSinkSharp()
• All four require builder.Services.AddHttpContextAccessor()
• SetGlobalLevel() / GetGlobalLevel() — change minimum level at runtime without restart
v1.0.5 — Per-sink level, filtering, middleware
• WriteTo(sink, minLevel) — per-sink minimum level; WithDashboard(out sink, minLevel)
• WithMachineName() — standalone MachineName enricher
• Filter(predicate) — drop events before enqueue, zero allocation for dropped events
• WithEnricher(enricher, when: predicate) — conditional enrichment
• app.UseSinkSharp() — X-Correlation-Id middleware + ElapsedTime stopwatch
v1.0.4 — Bug fixes: DisposeAsync idempotent; phone PII regex corrected for (555) 123-4567 format
v1.0.1 — Bug fix: email PII regex corrected
v1.0.0 — Initial release: striped async channel queue (1 per CPU core), MEL ILogger/ILoggerFactory, object pool, PII masking, CorrelationId enricher
See full changelog: https://github.com/SinkSharp/CHANGELOG.md
